decisions.decision: DESIGN GATE APPROVED (database). The watermark migration DELETEs the supercharger_sessions cursor rows rather than UPDATEing them in place -- roadmap Decision 10 stands.
decisions.why: Carrying the cursor is load-bearing on the nightly mirror never having stalled, unverifiable at migration time. DELETE costs ~nothing since the next pass re-reads everything anyway.
